A '''[[Sayormi]] mobile''' was a religious and ritualistic object which could be found hanging in the tents and hovels of those claiming leadership of the Sayormi tribe within the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]].
